title: Entrance to the World Beneath
content: Arthur Denison pilots his submersible toward the sunken entrance to the World Beneath. At right a flock of ammonoids drifts toward shipwrecks of galleons. The animals on the left are eurypterids, also known as sea scorpions, an extinct form that sometimes grew larger than a man.Painting is in oil, about 12 x 18 inches, fromDinotopia: The World Beneath
